RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: sleep
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: Inmates sleep in their cells. Cell doors lock once everyone is inside.

RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: lockup
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: Inmates are confined to their cells.

RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: eat
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: Inmates go to the canteen to eat.

RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: shower
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: Inmates go to the showers to wash.

RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: free time
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: Inmates may go to the yard and common rooms for recreation and fresh air.

RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: yard alone
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: An hour in a yard of their own, alone: a guard walks the inmate out and back (supermax). Only levels that keep inmates apart use it; for anyone else it is a lockup. Without a supermax yard it falls back to lockup.

RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.label: work
RimPrison.RegimeActivityDef.description: Inmates with a job go to work; others stay in their cells.
